info.name: Bank System API Suite
info.description: Automated API tests for the Group 1 banking API. Select the "Bank System - Local" environment, start the app with `docker compose up`, paste your API_KEY from .env into the environment's api_key, then Run the collection. Requests use the admin JWT saved at login (collection Authorization tab); the Security folder checks 401/403/422 with John's customer token, a fake token, and the API key. It creates its own test customer and accounts, so John's demo data is not changed.
